title: KUNG MACH Aero Frameset Review
notes: Seller-published ride review of a size-M white MACH frameset (dated May 2026). Reports a 1,150 g frame weighing, a 7.3 kg Shimano 105 Di2 build with FARSPORTS C6EVO wheels and an aluminium crank, very direct power transfer, a ride that is firm but not harsh, reach and stack close to a size-M Specialized SL8, non-round bar-end plugs, mismatched thru-axle colours and only a 10 mm-offset seatpost. The reviewer's employer sells the frameset.
